notes.title: DLC Toggle Fixed
notes.notes:
PATCH: The DLC Pickups Toggle now toggles the object off after checking if its purchased or not, if its not, its allowed to toggle off. 
Sorry about that :P

notes.title: Hide locked DLC pickups toggle added!
notes.notes:
Hide locked DLC pickups toggle added!


does what you think it does ;)

notes.title: Steam Item Check Fix
notes.notes: fixed checking for steam item unlocks after returning to main menu from game.

notes.title: Steam Inventory Item Drop Code Added
notes.notes: Added code to drop 1 steam inventory item per day when playing

notes.title: Speed Buff & Steam Inventory Items!
notes.notes:
NEW: added steam inventory items, collect them by playing and get rewarded automatically for playing!
Collect them all and try to get all the buffs!
Items: 
1. Stick Figure, does nothing, for trading only!
2. Speed Buff, buff player speed by +1.0!
3. Health Buff, buff player health by +50HP!
4. Damage Buff, buff player damage by +1.0!

notes.title: Backwards Walking!
notes.notes: I've updated the game mechanics to allow for backwards walking by default, you can change this setting in the pause menu to revert the controls and play the way you want!

notes.title: Improved Controls Menu Text
notes.notes:
Improved Controls Menu Text: Wrote some code to replace the "old" text in the controls menu with the updated code, as well as better align the buttons.

Have some plans for the future but they will be slow because I'm working on PROFOUND and a golf game as well as this. Plan to add lights to level editor eventually, with adjustable colors and intensity, ect. Plan to make some more levels, or perhaps a full campaign, but will come around to that later.

notes.title: New Music Player & Level Editor 2D Lights Toggle
notes.notes:
New Music Player: Added new music & player with buttons in pause menu to shuffle or play next song, controls music for all game levels
Level Editor 2D Lights Toggle: Added toggle in level editor for 2D lights, disabling it will disable all 2d lights in the custom level.

notes.title: Level Editor Weather Fix
notes.notes: Level Editor Weather Fix: fixed level editor weather settings not loading

notes.title: Traps & Level Editor Fix
notes.notes: Traps & Level Editor Fix: fixed player start pos in level editor & made traps damage multiple targets. You can now make "AFK EXP Farms" as intended with level editor.

notes.title: Multi Language Support, Weather Added.
notes.notes:
Multi Language Support: added Italian, French & Spanish languages in settings menu
Weather Added: Added rain & snow weather in level editor and added to some levels
Also added "Level Up Effect" that displays a purple aurora around the player as well as pop-up text when leveled up.
